description:
## Ultimea 1.4.4 (build 495, ARM64)

Adds four patches adapted from hxreborn:
- **Accent color:** presets, custom colors and Material You. Open **hxreborn patches** in Profile, then **Accent color**. Reopen the app to refresh all screens; wallpaper colors refresh on app launch.
- **Disable tracking:** Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Logan and usage uploads.
- **Remove distractions:** community, message and support entries, including the existing Explorer-tab removal.
- **Remove popups:** promotional and rating popups.

Select removal patches in Morphe Manager when patching; repatch to change them. Enable pre-releases for BadFella Patches, refresh Sources and repatch the original ARM64 app. Keep your existing Manager signing key to preserve app data.

Bluetooth/device-control implementations, all other native libraries and Flutter library loading are unchanged. The main activity is not automatically recreated for accent changes. The existing Feedback contrast issue is unchanged.

Build, regression tests and patching all six Ultimea patches together passed. Physical startup, picker appearance and soundbar reconnection still require device testing.

Includes GPL-3.0-only work by [hxreborn](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/tree/83839f596c9c7d8555c97809c34c2daabde03ec7); original notices are retained.
